issues.description: The problem specification (UML and text) indicates getTotalNumberOfStudents() should return an int, but the solution implementation returns a StudentCount object and even provides a StudentCount class. The template and UML expect a primitive int return (the UML shows +getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int and the task hints refer to an int). This mismatch will confuse students (they will implement an int-based method per the UML and template hints, but the solution uses a custom type) and the template does not include the StudentCount class, making the solution structure incompatible with the template and specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type across all artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to have getTotalNumberOfStudents() return an int (and remove or stop relying on StudentCount), updating getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() and getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() to use that int; or (B) update the problem statement/UML and the template to specify and provide the StudentCount type (add StudentCount to the template and update the UML to show StudentCount as the return type). Option A is recommended to match the current UML and template hints.

issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (a primitive int representing the total student count), but the solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return a StudentCount object and adds a new StudentCount class. This introduces a new identifier/type (StudentCount) for the same conceptual entity (total number of students), breaking the expected one-to-one mapping between the requirement and the implementation and creating unnecessary cognitive load for students.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type across artifacts. Preferably change the solution's getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return a primitive int (sum of inscribed and guest students) to match the problem UML and template expectations, and remove or repurpose the StudentCount wrapper class. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to explicitly require and document the StudentCount type so the introduced class is intentional and clearly explained.
